budget_items.topic: Municipal Building Design Committee construction cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The presenter gave trade costs for each building and the total construction cost including GC OH&P, with ARPA funding named as the source of the planning work.
budget_items.quote: total construction cost with gc oh&p: $17,840,917

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The presenter stated the average per-household cost under two bond terms.
budget_items.quote: a 30-year bond would be an average cost per household of $300 for a 30-year bond or $400 per household for a 20-year bond.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The presenter described earlier cost estimates for the TC Passios building, which rose after the pandemic, and the cost to bring it up to current code.
budget_items.quote: the cost estimation was 23 million then the pandemic hit and supplies skyrocketed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident asked how much had been spent; the Parks presenter listed the capital plan, special town meeting and ARPA amounts.
budget_items.quote: karin menard conﬁrms that $50,000 from capital plan has been approved.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Field rental fees were described as being used to pay for park expenses; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: conﬁrms that is an option and the fees are used to pay for expenses.

budget_items.topic: Other monied articles and free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said the other monied articles would all be free cash transfers, which were still undecided until Tuesday; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: the town manager conﬁrmed that other monied articles would be all free cash transfers

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Committee was told how the reduced debt service would be used: part to offset the capital program and the rest to balance the budget.
budget_items.quote: there is $393,881.14 in the reduced debt services this year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident asked whether not contributing to OPEB would affect the town's bond rating; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: inquires if there is a direct impact on the town's bond rating if the town does not contribute to opeb.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident encouraged departments to apply for the state ADA improvement grant and gave the statewide totals for FY 2024 and FY 2025.
budget_items.quote: in fy 2024, $3,932,321 were allocated to communities.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A committee member referred to grant-writing money meant to pay consultants; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: that money was to be used to contact consulting companies that write grants with the expertise to make it easier to get the grants.
